q: What is the CBAM figure for secondary aluminium remelted from scrap in Dubai?
title: Remelted scrap aluminium: CBAM figure
short: Mostly your own melting fuel. Aluminium scrap carries no embedded emissions under CBAM, so the figure is the direct emissions of melting, holding and casting, plus any primary aluminium or alloying precursors added. That usually makes it far lower than primary metal, if you can show the records.
audience: Secondary aluminium smelters and remelters in Dubai and the wider UAE exporting ingot or billet to the EU

ul: Gas or oil for melting and holding furnaces.
Primary aluminium added to adjust the alloy, at its embedded emissions.
Dross treatment on site, if it burns fuel.

p: Scrap purchase invoices by grade, furnace fuel meters, primary metal additions and output tonnes. Without them the importer may fall back on default values set for primary metal.

senseible: Senseible reads your fuel and electricity bills into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions your EU importer asks for, and its CBAM cost calculator estimates certificate cost from 2026 to 2034 for covered goods. Senseible does not verify emissions or file CBAM declarations.
